title: Microsoft presents MAI-Cyber-1-Flash, its first AI model for cybersecurity, at half the cost of competitors
summary: The model integrates into the MDASH agentic system and although it depends on OpenAI for complex tasks, it promises to improve digital defense.

title: Claude's shared chats are exposed in Google and Bing search results
summary: The privacy of AI conversations was compromised when they appeared in search engines.

title: Nvidia would guarantee $250 billion for OpenAI to have its own data center in Ohio
summary: The guarantee would allow the AI company to lease SoftBank's 10 gigawatt campus, with Nvidia as the main chip supplier.

title: Chinese memory manufacturer CXMT skyrockets 466% on its Shanghai stock exchange debut
summary: The company will focus investment on expanding DRAM production, with no immediate plans to manufacture HBM.

title: MSI and Colorful increase RTX 50 prices in China by up to 59% due to distribution changes
summary: The increase could spread to other markets and reflects upward pressure on GPU costs.

title: Minecraft Java Edition raises recommended RAM to 16 GB after 17 years without changes
summary: The popular game prepares for the transition to Vulkan and warns players about the new requirements.

title: AMD announces that Zen 7 will be the last CPU with AM5 socket and splits EPYC into three series for AI
summary: The new families Florence, Ferrara, and Fidenza will arrive in 2028 with a specific focus on artificial intelligence.

title: Moonshot AI releases open weights of Kimi K3, a model that competes with industry leaders
summary: The open source model offers performance almost comparable to frontier models but is much easier to run.

title: A player builds a Steam Deck with spikes, taser, and Raspberry Pi to prevent his family from using the battery
summary: The deterrent system includes a camera, speaker, and alarm that activate when the console is touched.

title: NVIDIA uses its own Vera CPU to develop future processors and graphics cards
summary: Initial tests show improved performance in automation tasks and chip design.

title: Apple delays its smart glasses until 2027 to ensure privacy compared to Meta's Ray-Ban
summary: The company seeks to differentiate itself without compromising user data protection.

title: Xbox suffers a global outage of its online services days after PlayStation's blackout
summary: The incident highlights the vulnerability of digital platforms to technical failures.

title: Sony promotes vinyl records while advancing the end of physical discs for PS5
summary: Players criticize the decision, but a former Rockstar Games director considers that losing the physical format is not a big problem.

title: An AI data center in Michigan is sued for the constant noise it generates, similar to a vacuum cleaner
summary: The company has been fined and offers to buy the homes of neighbors affected by the noise.

title: NVIDIA founds the Open Secure AI Alliance with 37 members, but without OpenAI, Google or Anthropic
summary: The open source alliance seeks to strengthen AI security after the breach suffered by OpenAI.

title: Forest fires in central Spain spread smoke to half the peninsula and mobilize aid
summary: Starlink offers free satellite internet, while the Ministry of Labor grants paid leave and operators launch an emergency service.
